moduleTitle: Accessing sourced data in a Case
learningObjectives: Configure Data Pages with the correct structure, object type, edit mode, scope, data source, and refresh strategy.
Choose between referencing and copying Data Page data, and apply simulated data sources for development and testing.

studyGuide.sectionTitle: Data Pages — Structure and Edit Modes

elements.text: Think of a shared whiteboard whose visibility depends on its room. Readers reuse its notes until a refresh condition calls for new information. The analogy describes caching; it does not imply one cache shared across every server.

elements.description: A Data Page loads from its configured source on demand and keeps results in memory. Access can reuse a cached instance or load missing/stale data. The source is not limited to external systems.
Two Data Page structure types:
items: PAGE — holds a SINGLE item (e.g., one customer record); accessed directly by property name
LIST — multiple items under pxResults; access a record with DataPageName.pxResults(n).

elements.description: Application code cannot edit the sourced contents in Read-Only mode; loading or refreshing from the source updates them. The cached values can become stale before a refresh.
Users can modify the cached data within the session. Appears in 'User Pages' category of the Clipboard tool. Example: a shipping address a user updates during checkout.

Changes made to the Data Page can be pushed back to the system of record via a save plan. Use when Pega must update the external source after user edits. Example: push-back approval updates the external HR system.

elements.description: Thread visibility isolates the cached page in a processing thread; the lesson uses separate Case transactions as its example.
Requestor visibility shares the cache across threads in the same user or system session.
Node visibility shares the cache among users and system tasks on that node. This is not a single cache across every node in a distributed deployment.

Data Transform, Activity, Connector, Report definition, Database lookup, Robotic Automation, Robotic desktop Automation, Aggregate sources, Lookup. Each specifies where Pega fetches data for the Data Page.

elements.term: When a Data Transform mapping is required
elements.description: The source lists response mapping for Report definition with List structure, Lookup with Page structure, Robotic Automation, and Robotic desktop Automation. Do not infer that every other source response automatically matches the target model.
Combines data from multiple sources into a single Data Page. Sources are populated in the listed order. Use when data must be merged from two or more systems.

When a Data Page has multiple sources, configure a condition on each to determine which Pega uses. Pega evaluates in order and uses the first matching condition. The last source has no condition — it acts as the 'Otherwise' fallback.
Parameters filter or limit what a Data Page loads. Example: load only auto insurance policies for one customer. Reference syntax: DataPageName[Param1_Name:Param1_Value, Param2_Name:Param2_Value].

Distinct parameter combinations can produce distinct cached instances within the configured scope. Limit to a single Data Page replaces the instance when parameters change; consider memory and reuse requirements.

elements.description: Defines when cached Data Page contents are considered stale and must be reloaded. Optional but strongly recommended. If at least one configured condition is met, Pega reloads the page from the data source.
Reload once per interaction supports Thread or Requestor scope and cannot combine with other refresh options. Multiple accesses in the same interaction do not each trigger a reload.

Uses a When Condition. If the condition returns TRUE → data is considered current, no reload occurs. Example: stock prices after trading day ends — condition 'marketClosed = true' prevents pointless reloads.

Reloads after a fixed time interval. After the interval expires, the next access triggers a reload. Example: seating inventory with a 10-min interval — if loaded at 12:00, it becomes stale at 12:10 and reloads on first access after.

elements.term: Key rule: max ONE reload per interaction
elements.description: For the configured refresh options described here, refresh happens at most once per interaction; repeated access reuses the refreshed contents.

elements.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 760 190" role="img" font-family="inherit"><title>Refresh on access, according to configuration</title><rect x="10" y="10" width="740" height="170" rx="12" fill="var(--pa-surface)" stroke="var(--pa-brand)"/><text x="30" y="42" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="var(--pa-brand)">Refresh on access, according to configuration</text><g font-size="14" fill="var(--pa-ink-2)"><text x="30" y="78">Time interval expires → stale → reload on next access.</text><text x="30" y="110">Once per interaction: Thread or Requestor; no combination.</text><text x="30" y="142">Reference freshness depends on the configured refresh policy.</text></g></svg>
elements.caption: Refresh on access, according to configuration.

studyGuide.sectionTitle: Autopopulation, UI Controls, and Simulated Data

elements.description: A reference points to the Data Page rather than a Case copy. Freshness depends on refresh configuration. Parameter changes select the appropriate instance; Limit to a single Data Page can replace the existing instance.

elements.term: Copy data from a Data Page
elements.description: Copy stores sourced values in a Case property. Later source changes alone do not update the copy. Changed parameters overwrite it with newly sourced values; removing the populated clipboard page can also cause a reload on next access. A copy is not automatically immutable.

elements.term: UI list from a Data Page
elements.description: Populate a dropdown or list from a Data Page instead of hardcoding values — avoids re-releasing the app when values change. Only the SELECTED value is saved to the Case's Data Model; the full list stays in the Data Page.

elements.term: Displayed value vs. copied value in UI lists
elements.description: In UI selection controls, displayed and stored values can differ:
items: DISPLAYED VALUE — what the user sees in the dropdown or list (e.g., country name)
COPIED VALUE — what gets saved to the Case (e.g., country code); configure via the Clipboard property mapping

elements.description: Simulated responses support development while an external source is unavailable or unfinished. Supply representative input/output data; simulation does not verify the real integration.

elements.term: Simulated data sources for unit testing
elements.description: Simulation lets you dictate the exact response returned by a source. This is valuable for unit testing — you control the response to verify different processing scenarios without depending on a live system.

elements.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 760 190" role="img" font-family="inherit"><title>Reference, copy and selected values</title><rect x="10" y="10" width="740" height="170" rx="12" fill="var(--pa-surface)" stroke="var(--pa-brand)"/><text x="30" y="42" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="var(--pa-brand)">Reference, copy and selected values</text><g font-size="14" fill="var(--pa-ink-2)"><text x="30" y="78">Reference follows the Data Page; a copy stores Case values.</text><text x="30" y="110">Changed parameters can replace copied values; copies can be edited.</text><text x="30" y="142">A dropdown stores its selected value, which can differ from its label.</text></g></svg>
elements.caption: Reference, copy and selected values.

examPitfalls.title: Data Pages are populated ON-DEMAND — not at application startup
examPitfalls.trapDescription: Questions ask when a Data Page's data is loaded. Candidates say 'when the application starts.' Data Pages are loaded on-demand — when the clipboard first requests the page during a user session, not at application or session startup.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: Data Pages are populated on-demand: when a Case needs data, Pega checks the Clipboard for a valid (non-stale) instance. If missing or stale, it queries the data source at that moment — NOT at startup.

examPitfalls.title: List structure uses pxResults — not direct access on the Data Page name
examPitfalls.trapDescription: An exam question asks how to access the third item in a list Data Page. Candidates write DataPageName(3) instead of DataPageName.pxResults(3), missing the required pxResults array that holds all list items.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: When structure is 'List', items are stored in the pxResults ordered array. Access via DataPageName.pxResults(n). A 'Page' structure holds a single item accessed directly by property name.

examPitfalls.title: Edit mode determines Clipboard category: Read-Only ≠ Editable
examPitfalls.trapDescription: Questions ask which Clipboard category a Read-Only Data Page appears under. Candidates choose 'Data Pages' for both modes, not realizing Editable Data Pages move to 'User Pages' in the Clipboard Viewer.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: Read-Only → 'Data Pages' Clipboard category. Editable → 'User Pages' Clipboard category. Savable enables write-back to the system of record via a save plan.

examPitfalls.title: Requestor scope ≠ Thread scope — they are different granularities
examPitfalls.trapDescription: Candidates think Requestor scope creates a separate instance per Case (like Thread), or that Thread scope is shared across a user's Cases (like Requestor).
examPitfalls.bestPractice: Thread isolates transaction context; Requestor shares across session threads; Node shares on the same node. Parameters also affect instance identity.

examPitfalls.title: Pega refreshes a Data Page at most ONCE per interaction — regardless of strategy
examPitfalls.trapDescription: A question asks whether a Data Page with 'Reload if older than' strategy can be refreshed multiple times in one interaction. Candidates say yes. Pega enforces a one-refresh-per-interaction limit — regardless of the refresh strategy, a Data Page is refreshed at most once per interaction.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: No matter how many times a Data Page is accessed in a single interaction, it is refreshed at most ONCE. Subsequent accesses in the same interaction always use the already-refreshed cached version.

examPitfalls.title: Parameterized Data Pages: each unique parameter set = a separate Clipboard instance
examPitfalls.trapDescription: Counting only users or only parameter values ignores configured scope and the single-instance option.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: Consider both scope and parameter combinations. Limit to a single Data Page replaces its cached instance as parameters change.

examPitfalls.title: UI list from Data Page: only the SELECTED value saves to the Case — not the full list
examPitfalls.trapDescription: Questions ask what data is saved to the Case when a user selects from a dropdown sourced from a Data Page. Candidates say 'the full Data Page list is embedded in the Case.' Only the selected value is saved — the full list is not embedded in the Case work object.
examPitfalls.bestPractice: When a dropdown is populated from a Data Page, only the value the user selects is copied to the Data Model. The full list remains in the Data Page only. Also: the saved value does not need to match the displayed label (e.g., code vs. name).

practiceQuiz.scenario: A Data Page must store a list of dental insurance plans with multiple entries. Which structure should be selected?

options.text: List — stores multiple items in an ordered pxResults array
Page — stores multiple items in a named property set
Collection — groups related pages together
Array — stores raw values without a wrapper class

practiceQuiz.hint: Identify the requested structure, visibility, refresh or persistence behavior; do not assume cache freshness.
practiceQuiz.rationale: List is the supported multi-record structure.

optionExplanations.A: List is the supported multi-record structure.
optionExplanations.B: Page represents one item rather than the requested list.
optionExplanations.C: Collection is not a Structure dropdown choice here.
optionExplanations.D: Array is not the named Structure option.

practiceQuiz.scenario: Which edit mode permits changing cached Data Page values without configuring a save plan for source write-back?

options.text: Editable
Read-Only
Savable
Thread-only

practiceQuiz.hint: Identify the requested structure, visibility, refresh or persistence behavior; do not assume cache freshness.
practiceQuiz.rationale: Editable permits local changes without a source save plan.

optionExplanations.A: Editable permits local changes without a source save plan.
optionExplanations.B: Read-Only prevents application edits to the sourced contents.
optionExplanations.C: Savable is intended to configure source write-back.
optionExplanations.D: Thread is a scope, not an edit mode.

practiceQuiz.scenario: Vehicle reference data should be cached for users and system tasks on the same server node. Which scope provides this visibility?

options.text: Node — shared by users and system tasks on that node
Requestor — each user's session has its own instance
Thread — isolated to the processing thread
Application — shared across all deployed applications

practiceQuiz.hint: Identify the requested structure, visibility, refresh or persistence behavior; do not assume cache freshness.
practiceQuiz.rationale: Node supplies the requested shared visibility on one node.

optionExplanations.A: Node supplies the requested shared visibility on one node.
optionExplanations.B: Requestor separates sessions instead of sharing across them.
optionExplanations.C: Thread is narrower than the requested node visibility.
optionExplanations.D: Application is not one of the three scope choices.

practiceQuiz.scenario: Which named Data Page source option combines multiple configured sources in their listed order?

options.text: Aggregate sources — combine data from multiple sources into one Data Page
Conditional sourcing — switch between sources based on a condition
Two separate Data Pages merged with a Data Transform
Database lookup — query both databases simultaneously

practiceQuiz.hint: Identify the requested structure, visibility, refresh or persistence behavior; do not assume cache freshness.
practiceQuiz.rationale: Aggregate is the named option for ordered combination.

optionExplanations.A: Aggregate is the named option for ordered combination.
optionExplanations.B: Conditional sourcing selects one matching source.
optionExplanations.C: A custom merge may be possible, but is not the named source option requested.
optionExplanations.D: Database lookup is not the multi-source combination option.

practiceQuiz.scenario: Assume the pricing feed remains unchanged outside its trading window. Which strategy uses that business condition to avoid unnecessary reloads?

options.text: Do not reload when — use a When Condition that is true when the market is closed
Reload once per interaction — loads fresh data on every user interaction
Reload if older than — set a 1-minute interval to keep data fresh
No refresh strategy — let the Data Page expire naturally

practiceQuiz.hint: Identify the requested structure, visibility, refresh or persistence behavior; do not assume cache freshness.
practiceQuiz.rationale: The When condition represents the specified no-change window.

optionExplanations.A: The When condition represents the specified no-change window.
optionExplanations.B: Repeated interaction refresh does not express that business condition.
optionExplanations.C: A fixed interval does not encode the trading-window rule.
optionExplanations.D: Omitting refresh does not implement the requested conditional policy.

practiceQuiz.scenario: A user accesses the same Data Page 5 times within a single interaction. The Data Page is configured with 'Reload once per interaction'. How many times does Pega refresh the Data Page?

options.text: At most once — Pega never refreshes a Data Page more than once per interaction
5 times — once per access as the name implies
0 times — the Data Page is cached indefinitely
Depends on the refresh strategy — could be 0 to 5 times

practiceQuiz.hint: Identify the requested structure, visibility, refresh or persistence behavior; do not assume cache freshness.
practiceQuiz.rationale: The policy allows at most one refresh in this interaction.

optionExplanations.A: The policy allows at most one refresh in this interaction.
optionExplanations.B: Access count does not multiply refreshes within the interaction.
optionExplanations.C: The selected policy does not mean indefinite caching.
optionExplanations.D: Five refreshes conflict with the configured interaction limit.

practiceQuiz.scenario: A Case should reference customer contact data instead of keeping a local snapshot. The team configures an appropriate refresh policy. Which autopopulation option fits?

options.text: Refer to the Data Page — values follow the referenced page and its refresh policy
Copy from the Data Page — captures the phone number at the time of Case creation
Use a Declare Expression — recalculates the field whenever the CRM updates
Use pyDefault — sets the phone number once at Case creation

practiceQuiz.hint: Identify the requested structure, visibility, refresh or persistence behavior; do not assume cache freshness.
practiceQuiz.rationale: A reference follows the page; freshness still depends on policy.

optionExplanations.A: A reference follows the page; freshness still depends on policy.
optionExplanations.B: A copy is a local snapshot instead of the requested reference.
optionExplanations.C: A Declare Expression alone does not subscribe to remote CRM changes.
optionExplanations.D: An initial default does not provide the requested reference.

practiceQuiz.scenario: Customer data should be copied when a claim is created so later source edits alone do not change those Case values. Assume parameters remain unchanged and no explicit reload or local edit occurs. Which option fits?

options.text: Copy data from the Data Page — stores a snapshot at the time of claim creation
Refer to the Data Page — values follow the referenced page
Use Thread scope — restricts data to the current Case only
Use 'Reload if older than' to prevent updates after the first load

practiceQuiz.hint: Identify the requested structure, visibility, refresh or persistence behavior; do not assume cache freshness.
practiceQuiz.rationale: Copy meets the stated snapshot requirement under these assumptions.

optionExplanations.A: Copy meets the stated snapshot requirement under these assumptions.
optionExplanations.B: A reference follows the page rather than preserving local values.
optionExplanations.C: Scope controls visibility, not copy semantics.
optionExplanations.D: An expiry interval can reload data rather than preserve a snapshot.

practiceQuiz.scenario: A dropdown offers 50 vehicle models. Its Sedan label maps to the stored code SED. Which data is copied into the selected Case field?

options.text: Only SED — the configured stored value of the selected entry
All 50 vehicle models — the entire list is stored in the Case
The first 10 vehicle models — the default page list size
Nothing — the list is display-only and no data is saved

practiceQuiz.hint: Identify the requested structure, visibility, refresh or persistence behavior; do not assume cache freshness.
practiceQuiz.rationale: SED is the stored value explicitly mapped in this scenario.

optionExplanations.A: SED is the stored value explicitly mapped in this scenario.
optionExplanations.B: Choosing an entry does not embed every offered model.
optionExplanations.C: There is no ten-entry copy rule for this selection.
optionExplanations.D: The configured selection does copy its stored value.

practiceQuiz.scenario: Which built-in external-source simulation approach lets the team test weather UI responses before its API is ready?

options.text: Simulate the external data source — provide sample data so the team can build and test without the real API
Create a Read-Only Data Page with hardcoded placeholder values
Wait until the API is ready to avoid integration issues
Use a Declare Expression to generate test weather data automatically

practiceQuiz.hint: Identify the requested structure, visibility, refresh or persistence behavior; do not assume cache freshness.
practiceQuiz.rationale: Simulation supplies controlled responses while the API is unfinished.

optionExplanations.A: Simulation supplies controlled responses while the API is unfinished.
optionExplanations.B: Placeholder values are not the built-in simulation approach requested.
optionExplanations.C: Waiting does not exercise the requested UI testing approach.
optionExplanations.D: An expression is not the documented external-source simulation feature.

practiceQuiz.scenario: Which TWO statements correctly describe Data Page visibility?

options.text: Thread scope isolates the cached page in a processing thread
Node scope shares the cache among users and tasks on that node
Requestor scope creates a separate Data Page instance for each Case for the same user
Node scope is per-user — each user gets their own Node instance

practiceQuiz.hint: Identify the requested structure, visibility, refresh or persistence behavior; do not assume cache freshness.
practiceQuiz.rationale: Thread provides isolated processing context. Node shares within the node rather than by individual user.

optionExplanations.B: Node shares within the node rather than by individual user.
optionExplanations.C: Requestor shares across its session threads, not separately per Case.
optionExplanations.D: Node scope is not a per-user cache.

practiceQuiz.scenario: Which TWO scenarios are valid uses for simulated external data sources in Pega Platform?

options.text: Testing when the source system has no data available yet
Unit testing by dictating specific response values to verify different processing paths
Permanently replacing a production data source with simulated data
Automatically refreshing Data Pages when real source data changes

practiceQuiz.hint: Identify the requested structure, visibility, refresh or persistence behavior; do not assume cache freshness.
practiceQuiz.rationale: Sample responses allow testing before source data is available. Controlled responses exercise specific test paths.

optionExplanations.A: Sample responses allow testing before source data is available.
optionExplanations.B: Controlled responses exercise specific test paths.
optionExplanations.C: Permanent production substitution is not the development/testing purpose asked about.
optionExplanations.D: Simulation does not itself implement real-source refresh detection.

practiceQuiz.scenario: Which TWO design choices directly control external retrieval and stale-cache handling for a customer Data Page? Refresh configuration is optional but recommended.

options.text: The data source — specifying the connector and operation that retrieves the data from the external system
The refresh strategy — defining when the cached data is invalidated and re-fetched from the source
The class hierarchy level — specifying which parent class in the hierarchy the Data Page should delegate to
The Ruleset version — locking the Data Page to a specific Ruleset minor version to prevent version conflicts

practiceQuiz.hint: Identify the requested structure, visibility, refresh or persistence behavior; do not assume cache freshness.
practiceQuiz.rationale: The source configuration identifies the external retrieval operation. Refresh policy controls stale-cache handling; it is not mandatory merely to load data.

optionExplanations.A: The source configuration identifies the external retrieval operation.
optionExplanations.B: Refresh policy controls stale-cache handling; it is not mandatory merely to load data.
optionExplanations.C: Superclass delegation is not the retrieval or refresh mechanism requested.
optionExplanations.D: Locking a minor Ruleset version does not configure retrieval or stale-cache handling.

quickRecap.value: Structure (Page/List), Object Type, Edit Mode (Read-Only/Editable/Savable), Scope (Thread/Requestor/Node).
Page = single item. List = multiple items in pxResults array. Access: DataPageName.pxResults(n).
Read-Only → 'Data Pages'. Editable → 'User Pages'. Savable → pushes data back to system of record.
Thread: transaction context. Requestor: session. Node: same node; not a distributed system-wide singleton.

quickRecap.key: Data sources requiring Data Transform mapping
quickRecap.value: Report definition with List; Lookup with Page; Robotic Automation; Robotic desktop Automation.
Aggregate = combine data from multiple sources. Conditional = pick ONE source based on conditions (last = 'Otherwise' fallback).
Scope and parameter combinations identify instances. Limit to a single Data Page replaces the instance as parameters change.
Reload once per interaction (Thread/Requestor only). Do not reload when (When Condition). Reload if older than (time interval).
At most ONCE per interaction, regardless of how many times the Data Page is accessed.
Reference freshness follows refresh policy. Copy stores values locally; changed parameters or explicit reload can replace them.
Only the SELECTED VALUE is saved to the Data Model. Displayed label ≠ saved value (e.g., country name displayed, country code saved).
Dev/test without real API or data. Use when: API not ready, source empty, unit testing with controlled responses.
